annotations.selection: The two Serialize implementation witnesses are in this feature-scoped module; the project SourceProfile must select it exactly for the printer serde feature.
annotations.qualification: Real Serialize implementation declarations delegate to the sequential bodies. The locked external serde trait identity, feature selection, coherence and target linkage still require their actual owners.
annotations.borrows: StatsSerialize passes the original seven field references through stats:BorrowFields. Each serializer state call borrows its live state exclusively for one call; DurationSerialize borrows each original secs/nanos/human temporary only through that call, then releases it before the next field.
